notes: Applicants with a foreign diploma (Moroccan Baccalauréat) from a country with a Campus France Etudes en France procedure must apply via Etudes en France, not Parcoursup, as stated on the programme page: "vous ne devez pas vous inscrire sur Parcoursup ... Vous devez faire vos démarches sur le site de Campus France de votre pays de résidence". The Parcoursup page states the fee as "Par année 178 euros", which is the figure for EU/EEA students; no tuition figure for extra-community students is given for this programme, so tuition is left out. The C1 French level is stated on the page for the programme itself. A TOEIC certificate is mentioned among "Certifications proposées" by the IUT (CISCO CCNA/CCNP, STORMSHIELD, TOEIC), not as an admission requirement, so it is not listed as an accepted test.
